global._doc_wg_bind_ip: Caddy's wg0 IP on gcp-proxy (10.0.0.1) — every public *.diegonmarcos.com site block dual-binds to (0.0.0.0, wg_bind_ip). Caddy lives on gcp-proxy (the public-facing VM); reverse-proxy upstreams to internal services traverse the wg0 mesh (10.0.0.x). Engine resolveVmIpForCaddy() still prefers wg-public IPs (10.1.0.x) when both endpoints are peers — gcp-proxy is a wg-public peer (10.1.0.2) so mail-side upstreams keep using wg-public transit.
global._doc_wg_cidrs: Source CIDRs that count as "on the mesh" for every wg_only / bearer gate caddyfile.nix emits (@wg, @not_wg). Mirrors config.json wireguard.subnet + wireguard.subnet_v6. The wg0 mesh went dual-stack on 2026-07-26 but this gate stayed IPv4-only, so any client resolving the AAAA record (fd0c:1d00::1 — Hickory serves both, and clients prefer IPv6) arrived from fd0c:1d00::/64, missed the matcher and got 403. Keep both families listed or mesh-only routes break for IPv6-capable peers. Space-separated: Caddy remote_ip takes a CIDR list.

multi_sso._doc: MULTI-SSO (#1066). ONE flag. ON since 2026-10-21 (guard: src/test/test-multi-sso.sh pins this state and proves the ON render only ADDS to the OFF render; OFF/absent renders the pre-multi-SSO Caddyfile). enabled=true: the auth vhost also answers every host in `hosts` (account.diegonmarcos.com; DNS is covered by the wildcard record, TLS is on-demand), serves the four-button chooser (Authelia, Cloudflare One, Google, GitHub) on GET / for a browser with no Authelia session, proxies /oauth2/<provider>/* to the auth broker (device flow and web flow for GitHub, web code flow + PKCE for Google, Cloudflare Access login bridge for Cloudflare One; infra-sec_auth-broker, on oci-apps over the mesh), and the shared edge gate accepts a broker session cookie as a third credential beside the fleet Bearer and the Authelia session. The broker only admits `allowed_emails`. Per-provider switches live in infra-sec_auth-broker/build.json (providers[].enabled); a switched-off provider's button is hidden by the chooser.

chooser._doc: The sign-in chooser page served on the auth vhost (src/sso-chooser.html), GENERATED from this block, `providers` above and src/sso-chooser.tpl.html by src/gen-sso-chooser.py (test/test-sso-chooser.sh fails on drift). Self-contained: no third-party request at runtime. `order` is the button order (digit keys 1..n pick them); `authelia` is the portal entry that is not a broker; `hints` are the one-line captions; `links` are the footer icon links (public pages).

cloudflare_access._doc: Cloudflare Access JWT as the third credential (after the Authelia session and the broker cookie): a request carrying Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion and neither cookie is sent to the broker's <prefix>/cf-auth, which verifies it against the team certs and the AUDs in infra-sec_auth-broker/build.json auth_broker.cloudflare_access (owner email only). Only active while multi_sso.enabled is true.

edge_auth._doc: THE edge auth policy, one list, three tiers. Every public URL is exactly one of: (a) private -- mesh/WireGuard only (route wg_only:true, or a *.app/.db/s3 name), answered 403 to any non-mesh source and never served by the public edge (caddy-public); (b) public-protected -- the DEFAULT for anything public: the shared (edge_auth) snippet requires `Authorization: Bearer <fleet token>` (introspect-proxy) OR a valid Authelia session cookie, else 401 (API / non-browser) or 302 to auth. (browser); (c) public-open -- anonymous allowed, ONLY what is listed in public_open / technical below, each with a reason. Adding a host to public_open is the only way to make something anonymous; add more entries here. The CI guard (cloud-infra 9_others/test/edge-auth-gate.test.sh) fails on a public site that is in no tier, in two tiers, or open without an entry here. Rendered by _shared/edge-auth.nix into BOTH Caddyfiles (hub infra-sec_caddy, edge infra-sec_caddy-public); the derive copies this block into build-caddy.json and build-caddy-edge.json.

public_open.reason: The IdP itself: login portal and OIDC endpoints (authorize / token / JWKS / discovery) cannot require the token or session they exist to issue.
Owner decision 2026-10-16: the public link page is deliberately anonymous.

Routing tier pub (#1104): Cloudflare-proxied, explicit unauthenticated allowlist only (_shared/fleet-addressing.json tiers.pub); every other path answers 404 and no upstream is reachable beyond the listed paths.

Owner decision 2026-10-16 + item 5 (MCP auth discovery): a claude.ai MCP connector completes the OAuth sign-in BEFORE it holds a token -- discovery metadata (RFC 9728 / RFC 8414, incl. per-resource variants), Dynamic Client Registration (/register), /authorize, /token and the callback. The tool endpoints (/<route>/mcp) stay Bearer-protected; a request to any of these paths is answered by the MCP side itself.

Owner decision 2026-10-16: the tracker script and its event-collection endpoint are loaded by anonymous visitors of the public websites (umami script.js + /api/send; Matomo's tracker equivalents). Dashboards, the reporting APIs (matomo api.php, umami /api/*) and OpenObserve stay protected.

Owner decision 2026-10-16: other homeservers federate and discover this one without credentials. Owner decision 22: the Matrix client API (/_matrix/client/*) is open for Element web and token-less clients -- the homeserver does its own auth. Media and everything else stays protected.
Owner decision 22: Mattermost mobile login and API -- Mattermost does its own authentication on /api/v4/*. The web UI stays gated.
Owner decision 22: git-over-HTTPS (smart HTTP) with Basic auth and the Gitea API -- Gitea does its own authentication; git clients cannot do a cookie/bearer handshake. The web UI stays gated.

Routing tier public HTML (#1104, owner ruling 2026-10-22): the apex and www are the ONLY unauthenticated public hosts. Static landing page plus WKD (OpenPGP public keys by design) and the /.well-known/jmap autoconfig redirect.
Routing tier public HTML (#1104, owner ruling 2026-10-22): www and the apex are the ONLY unauthenticated public hosts; static landing page.
Owner ruling 2026-10-22 (#1104): GitHub Pages custom domain, explicit public HTML host without auth; the content is public on github.io anyway.
Owner ruling 2026-10-22 (#1104): GitHub Pages custom domain, explicit public HTML host without auth; the content is public on github.io anyway.
Owner ruling 2026-10-22 (#1104): GitHub Pages custom domain, explicit public HTML host without auth; the content is public on github.io anyway.

Routing tier (#1104, owner ruling 2026-10-22): there is NO public wildcard route. This catch-all serves nothing: an undeclared subdomain is redirected to the apex and reaches no upstream. Guard: _shared/test-fleet-addressing.mjs.
Owner decision 22: MTA-STS policy (RFC 8461) is fetched anonymously by sending MTAs.

Owner decision 2026-10-16: the wstunnel client opens a WebSocket upgrade to a secret path prefix and cannot do a cookie/bearer handshake. The exemption is `Upgrade: websocket` only; wstunnel itself rejects every upgrade whose path is not its secret --http-upgrade-path-prefix, and every non-upgrade request to vpn. is gated.

bearer_passthrough.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-18: mail clients log in with a Stalwart OAuth or API token in `Authorization: Bearer`, which introspect-proxy (Authelia/fleet tokens) can never recognise, so the edge answered 401 and the client never reached Stalwart. The edge no longer introspects Bearer here; Stalwart validates it and answers its own 401. Still protected: Stalwart requires auth on every JMAP route, a request with NO Authorization still goes to the Authelia branch and is refused at the edge, X-Fleet-Authorization is still introspected, and the jmap rate limit stays.
Same as jmap.: the mails. vhost serves the same Stalwart JMAP surface to the same clients.

technical.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-16: ACME http-01 validation requests come from the CA and cannot carry a token. Exempted on EVERY host (the path is excluded from the gate). Caddy core answers a live token before any route runs; this fleet itself issues via DNS-01.

Browsers never attach credentials to a CORS preflight. The (edge_auth) snippet answers it itself with 204; it is never proxied to an upstream, so it serves no content. Plain OPTIONS (WebDAV discovery) is NOT exempt.
IMAPS / SMTPS are not HTTP: caddy-l4 forwards the raw TLS stream to Stalwart, which authenticates the mail login itself. There is no HTTP request to carry a bearer or cookie.

catch_all._redirect_doc: Undeclared subdomains have no route (#1104, owner ruling 2026-10-22): 302 to the apex, ungated, no upstream (caddyfile.nix catchAllBlock). page stays as the edge's fallback file.

messages.db_catalog_template: DB catalog — container={container} engine={engine} port={port} upstream={upstream} path={path} vm={vm}

mail_l4_routes.comment: IMAPS via SNI on :443 -> STALWART :2993 (2026-09-02). Maddy :993 (go-imap v1) advertises no CONDSTORE/QRESYNC/UIDPLUS, which forces clients into a full flag rescan of every synced folder each poll -- measured on-device: 9355 UID FLAGS fetches per 15-min pass, all night, phone dead at 04:49. Stalwart :2993 advertises CONDSTORE+QRESYNC+UIDPLUS+IMAP4rev2. The earlier objection to :2993 (IMAP clients see Stalwart's ENTIRE 1*-9* + A*-F* tree because JMAP and IMAP share one store) is mitigated by the subscription policy in mail-rules-profile-diego.json folder_options: only INBOX + the F* sender folders are subscribed, and clients honouring LSUB/subscriptions see the intended menu. Maddy keeps :25 inbound and its store stays intact for rollback: revert this upstream to oci-mail:993.
SMTPS via SNI on :443 → Stalwart :2465 (Maddy's :465 is legacy)

public_routes.comment: WireGuard-over-TCP/443 fallback for hostile networks (airport / hotel / corporate guest Wi-Fi blocking UDP). Sibling to bb-net_wireguard-mesh (the panel) — this folder owns the wstunnel-server that terminates WSS on gcp-proxy and forwards UDP to the kernel WG listener at 127.0.0.1:51820. UDP/51820 remains the primary transport; this kicks in only when clients can't reach UDP.
SSO and 2FA authentication portal
Continuwuity Matrix homeserver (maintained conduwuit fork, Rust/RocksDB) — central hub for chat bridges. Federation enabled via .well-known delegation over :443.

paths.comment: C3 REST API — Cloud Control Center Fastify API

C3 Public API — single public-edge listener on oci-analytics. Consolidates http-to-smtp-proxy-api (Bearer-gated /mail/*) and c3-analytics-api passthrough (public /analytics/*). Replaces split listeners across gcp-proxy + oci-analytics so gcp-proxy becomes a pure wg0 spoke.

Git Proxy API — Authelia-fronted read path to GitHub so the phone holds NO GitHub credential (#647, route 3 of #646's fallback chain). The caller authenticates to US with the Authelia bearer it already has; this service holds the GitHub token server-side and streams the result back.
Unified scrapers API (Instagram / Pinterest / LinkedIn / generic crawl) — retires crawlee-cloud. Lean single-container FastAPI, on-demand, flat-JSON output.

public_path_routes.comment: API hub -- path-based routing to backend APIs
